newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Inkombank to receive $27 mln credit.
newsitem.headline: Russian Inkombank to receive $27 mln credit.

text.p: Russian bank Inkombank said on Friday it had signed an agreement on Thursday on a $27 million syndicated credit from an international consortium of banks led by Bank Austria AG.

The 12-month unguaranteed credit, which will be used to to finance short-term investments and trading activities of bank clients, pays annual interest of 4.375 percentage points over LIBOR, it said in a statement.
Inkombank, which is one of the top five Russian banks by assets, received two other credits, $20 million and $25 million respectively, in 1996.
Inkombank assets totalled 16 trillion roubles at the beginning of the year and capital was 1.9 trillion roubles. Both figures were calculated according to Russian accounting standards.
